sort-list.quickAnswer: Sorts lines alphabetically in either direction: paste one item per line and get the sorted list back instantly. Options for numeric-aware sorting (Item 2 before Item 10) and case-sensitive ordering, with one-click copy and .txt download. Great for name lists, keywords, inventories and cleanup workflows.

sort-list.workedExample:
Input (3 lines):
cherry
banana
Apple

A–Z, case-insensitive:
Apple
banana
cherry

Z–A of the same list:
cherry
banana
Apple

Numeric-aware example:
Input: Item 10, Item 2 -> Output: Item 2, Item 10
mistakes: Sorting 'Item 1, Item 2, Item 10' as plain text — you get 1, 10, 2; turn on numeric-aware sorting for the sane order.
Forgetting leading spaces — ' apple' sorts before 'Zebra' because spaces come first; trim your list.
Assuming it removes duplicates — sorting only reorders; identical lines stay, so dedupe separately.
Using case-sensitive sort by accident — all capitals clump at the top and the order surprises you.
Sorting mixed scripts (English + Arabic) — Unicode ordering is not dictionary ordering, so check the result.
